CA.rationale: No attention/allocation condition linking to identified content present.

COD.rationale: Content (coordinate set for 'red'), an explicit organization/presentation (the coordinate pattern), and a separate origin/status field are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content sets (color-labeled coordinate lists) for named referents and times.

D.rationale: An explicit origin/status field (origin=...) is provided separately from the content coordinate lists, distinguishing content identity from provenance/status.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented as organized coordinate patterns (including current and conditional candidate patterns).
